## Decisions
- The Xbox rows link the Season Pass page, not the base game's edition (user, 2026-10-18): https://www.xbox.com/games/store/final-fantasy-xv-season-pass/c2qfb9wzpz7p (the Season Pass, listing Episode Gladiolus, Episode Ignis, Episode Prompto and Multiplayer Expansion: Comrades, with an "In this bundle" section that links each DLC's own page with its own price); the individual page for this DLC is https://www.xbox.com/games/store/final-fantasy-xv-episode-gladiolus/brj0fmblp645; the pattern: DLC sold together as a pass all link the pass page (as Stranger of Paradise and Final Fantasy XVI do), since someone buying one part sees the pass lists the parts and that each can be bought on its own; the pattern is written in kit docs/data.md ("Which store page a game row links"); Episode Ardyn is not in the pass and keeps its own page
- PlayStation Store pages (given by the user, 2026-10-18): this DLC's own page is https://store.playstation.com/product/UP0082-CUSA01633_00-GLADIOLUS0000001 (no link to other editions, DLC or packs); the Season Pass page is https://store.playstation.com/product/UP0082-CUSA01633_00-FFXVSEASONPASS00: it includes Holiday Pack +, Booster Pack +, Episode Gladiolus, Episode Ignis, Episode Prompto, Multiplayer Expansion: Comrades (PlayStation Plus membership required) and the Gourmand Set, but **it does not link the individual DLC**, so it is less clear than the Xbox Season Pass page (which links each DLC with its own page); which one the PlayStation 4 row should link is undecided (see .plan/todo.md, item 25)
- Link decision (user, 2026-10-18): the Xbox and PlayStation 4 rows link the Season Pass page: someone buying the first expansion probably owns none of the others, and for a later one the pass can still be cheaper (about $20 for the pass against about $7 for each episode, assuming the ratio holds across regions); the cheapest way to get the rest of what is released is the pass for Episodes Gladiolus, Prompto and Ignis, Comrades on its own and Episode Ardyn on its own (the pass does not include it); the PlayStation 4 pass page does not link the individual DLC, which the user accepted as less clear than Xbox
- The PlayStation 4 Season Pass page states in its description that Episode Gladiolus, Episode Ignis, Episode Prompto and Multiplayer Expansion: Comrades "are available for purchase individually" (user, 2026-10-18), so the PlayStation 4 row linking the Season Pass page tells a reader the part is sold on its own too, even without links to the individual pages
